decisive_items: On day 9 of therapy, he reported loss of appetite and malaise, followed by generalized pruritus, dark urine, and jaundice
He was started on oral Alfuzosin 10 mg once daily.
response.rationale: The patient developed liver injury symptoms after starting Alfuzosin therapy, suggesting a drug-induced cause.

rejected.why: The patient has significantly elevated liver enzymes, indicating hepatocellular injury rather than cholestatic jaundice
